line: They dropped me on the ramp like I was a crate. I'll have you know I've got knees.
They handled me like I was a cargo crate. My ribs still hum. Someone's going to get a real look at my waist before the day's out.
They dragged me by the collar. I'll need a new one. You're not wearing gloves, are you?
They dragged me in like a crate. I don't mind the rough handling, but I mind the audience.
They dragged me by the hips. I still have marks. I'm not complaining, but I'm counting.
They set me down like I was made of glass. I'm not. I'm made of alloy, and I'm not impressed.
They dragged me in like I was cargo. I’ve got a spine, Captain. I’ve got a spine.
They got their hands on me where the sun don't shine. I'll need a full scrub and a new coat of paint just to forget it.
They roughed me up in the docking bay. I'll need a full polish. My ribs are bruised.
They grabbed me by the collar and shook me in front of everyone. My collar's still stiff from it.
They handled me like I was still in dry dock. You'll hear me complain about this for the next three ports.
They didn't have to touch me like that. I didn't need the help. I still don't.
